title: The Rt. Rev. Richard Chenevix Trench
dates: (9 Sept 1807-27 Mar 1886)
---

Archbishop of Dublin

He married (1 June 1832) his cousin the Hon.

Frances Mary Trench (d. 5 Nov 1890).

He served as Archbishop of Dublin 1864-84; he was a distinguished philologist; he was first cousin once removed to T.R.F.

Cooke Trench.
